text.tspan: Over the 1-month period (Oct 4 -> Nov 3), the Core Backend & Infra team
finalized the API v2 Migration architecture and validated the new Redis
Benchmarks confirmed a 38% reduction in p99 latency (340ms on
/v2/summarize), clearing the path for staging deployment and full v1
